### Priority Passengers (Regular Fare, Flexi Plus, or Priority Add-on)

This allowance applies to passengers who book a Regular or Flexi Plus fare, or who add the Priority & 2 Cabin Bags option. The current allowance is:

 1 x Small Personal Item (max. 40 x 30 x 20cm)
 1 x 10kg Cabin Bag (max. 55 x 40 x 20cm)

results.title: Ryanair Baggage Allowance - Everything you Need to Know
results.content:
##### Fees per the Ryanair Table of Fees, correct as of June 2026. Booking prices vary by route and date and are cheaper online than at the airport. A non-priority 10 kg bag taken to the gate goes in the hold for £/€46–60; an oversize cabin bag (over 55 x 40 x 20 cm) at the gate costs £/€70–75. No single bag may exceed 32 kg / 70 lb.
